# febwebdev

> Portfolio of Febelyn, a WordPress developer with 10+ years of experience and 5+ years working remotely with agencies. Febelyn builds WordPress sites from approved Figma designs, fixes sites when they stop working, and looks after live sites. Open to a long-term remote WordPress role. Time zone: UTC+8.

## What Febelyn does

- Builds WordPress sites from Figma designs that look right on desktop, tablet and phone, and that clients can edit themselves (Gutenberg, Kadence, reusable patterns).
- Sets up WordPress for editors: ACF fields, custom post types, taxonomies and PHP templates, so routine changes happen in WordPress, not in code.
- Fixes problems on live sites: contact forms that don't deliver email, plugin conflicts, layout bugs, cross-browser issues.
- Looks after live client sites: updates, layout fixes and checks before anything is handed back.
- Works in whatever page builder a team already uses: Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, Bricks, WPBakery, SiteOrigin, Avada.
- Is learning to use AI tools where they save time, and still tests every page and form personally.

## Selected work

- Fixed: contact form messages weren't reaching the client. Traced it through Gravity Forms entries, notification logs, the SMTP connector and reCAPTCHA settings, and fixed the real cause.
- Shipped: villa bookings with live availability. A date picker fed by an iCal calendar, minimum-stay rules, pricing with taxes and fees, and a Gravity Forms enquiry.
- Shipped: a portfolio the client can update without a developer. Moved hand-built pages into custom post types with a filterable grid.
- Shipped: approved Figma designs built in Gutenberg and Kadence with reusable patterns.
- Demo: an animated, keyboard-friendly solar and battery explainer: https://febwebdev.github.io/demos/ssc-energy-flow/

## Toolbox

- Build: Gutenberg, Kadence, Genesis, GeneratePress, child themes, HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript
- Content: ACF Pro, custom post types, taxonomies, PHP templates, shortcodes
- Forms and stores: Gravity Forms, WooCommerce, SMTP, reCAPTCHA
- QA: Chrome DevTools, BrowserStack, LambdaTest, Lighthouse, GTmetrix
- Teamwork: Figma, ClickUp, Asana, Slack, written handoff notes
